name: New Real State

motion.tour: photo-chapters: each room photograph uncovered from its foot over the last with a settle from scale 1.06, scrubbed to scroll, about two thirds of a screen per chapter; static chapters under reduced motion
motion.statement: word-highlight: words turn from half ink to ink as they cross the middle of the screen
motion.button: hover step and press scale from the kit motion layer; 180ms ease
motion.copy-code: label swap with filter blur(2px) and opacity .6 for 120ms, reverts after 2s

focus: 2px outline in logo cobalt (#0069ff), shown at once, never animated
